name: Reu
overview: Reu is a male biblical figure identified primarily as the son of Peleg. Scripture records him in the genealogical line found in Genesis, highlighting his place in the early generations after the flood. There are no additional tribal affiliations or notable personal details provided beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Reu means "friend" in Hebrew, as noted in Genesis 11:18. This is the only recorded name for him, and it was not given directly by God but is a proper name used in the biblical genealogies.
familyAndRelationships: Reu is explicitly identified as the father of Serug and is inferred to be the son of Peleg. These relationships place him in the direct ancestral line leading to later patriarchs, emphasizing his role in the biblical genealogy.
scriptureSignificance: Reu's significance lies in his position within the genealogical record of Genesis, connecting the generations from Peleg to Serug. This lineage is foundational for understanding the descent of the patriarchs and God's providential preservation of His covenant people. While Reu himself is not the focus of specific narrative events, his place in the genealogy underscores the continuity of God's plan throughout generations.
